$comment: Professor Diki Simplified design tokens v2.0.0 (16 Oct 2026): the paper cut-out collage house style for every subject (PD-19), brand only as an opening ident and on the end card (PD-21), no on-screen or spoken disclosure line (PD-20). Single source for tokens.css and tokens.js (run tools/build_tokens.py; never edit the generated files). Canvas 1080x1920, px at 1080 wide, times in seconds. Reference look: 16_pilot_builds_2026-10-16/biology/opus (scenes/_src/build_scenes.py + engine.js). Floors from SZ = 12_advanced_animations_with_claude/04_harness_contract/vertical_safe_zones.tokens.json v1.0.2 and A2 = audit/A2_visual_explanation.md section 10.

color.$comment: COLLAGE palette (reference build_scenes.py :root). Hue names are paint; roles below say what each one means. Text never sits on a band directly: it sits on a chip, a sheet or a sticker plate (build_tokens.py checks every text role on every surface listed in 'surfaces' and writes the ratios to 'contrast'). Accent TEXT roles are the hues darkened just enough for >= 4.5:1 on the lightest-to-darkest paper (paper, cream, grid, outline); the bright originals stay in 'fill' for chips, sticker bodies and large shapes.

surfaces.$comment: Every background a text role can sit on. paper = sheets (result, card, think plate, end-card line); cream = the page base between bands (only the ident and chips sit there, never bare text); grid = grid-paper chips and the chemistry bench; outline = sticker plates (ammeter face, atom H).

fill.$comment: bright fills for chips, sticker bodies and halos: colour by meaning inside the collage palette (voltage royal blue, current teal, resistance/condition mustard, mismatch brick). Text ON these fills uses chips.styles fg (checked).

line.$comment: LINE roles for strokes >= 5 px that carry meaning (wires, connectors, strike lines, arrows). Checked >= 3:1 against every band and paper they cross.

chem.$comment: Atom stickers (cream outline + soft shadow). The element letter is always drawn (never colour-only). O is orange, not red, because red (brick) means mismatch. 'coefficient' is a TEXT colour on the formula sheet.

bio.$comment: Material vs energy differ in hue AND line style (solid arrow vs dashed wave) AND label. Both are graphics (>= 3:1 on paper and on the sky). The carbon tracer is the chem C sticker so carbon looks the same everywhere. Compartments are taped paper sheets tinted in turn (sky, grass, butter, blush); station text is ink on the tint (checked >= 4.5) and arrows are two-tone (cream outline under the stroke).

chips.$comment: Ransom-note word chips (reference engine.js TILE_STYLES plus royal blue). One chip per word, cream outline, soft double shadow, rotation +-3 deg and dy +-4 px from the seeded PRNG by chip index, headline chips cycle headline_styles (black, mustard, grid, teal, cream) with a step coprime to their count so neighbours differ; royal (voltage) and brick (mismatch) are NOT in the cycle, so those two hues only ever carry their science meaning.

roles.$comment: label chips on the board: colour by meaning. condition/resistance = mustard chip, voltage = royal, current = teal, mismatch = brick, neutral label = grid, result = black.
roles.label: grid

sticker.$comment: Cut-out sticker = SVG filter: dilate the shape by 'outline' px, flood it with the outline cream, two drop shadows (reference #cut). HTML chips/sheets use the same outline as a border and 'shadow' as box-shadow.

tape.$comment: Washi tape strips (reference .tape): pink, mustard, teal at the reference alphas; 110 x 32 px, rotated -4..-5 deg, half over the sheet edge.

sheet.$comment: Paper sheet = the result lane, the card lane, the think plate, the formula sheet. Cream paper, 8 px die-cut outline, soft double shadow, washi tape. Never a flat white panel.

world.$comment: Full-bleed torn-paper world per subject, behind every lane (it carries nothing to read). Base = cream page + paper sky (soft sky washes and cream clouds, displaced by a fixed-seed feTurbulence wash). Bands are torn-paper strips, top edge at a lane reference ('diagram.y0+6') or a px value, seeded jitter (build-time-free: generated once in ready() from the band seed, never per frame), a cream fibre edge and a 3 px shadow. Textures: speckle (dots), grain (wood lines), rules (grid). Paper grain (fixed-seed fractal noise) and a soft vignette over everything; four ink sparkles in the corners. Every band is LIGHT or mid-tone (relative luminance >= band_min_luminance, checked by build_tokens.py; founder: 'if possible don't use dark colours', PD-17). Dark is allowed only on small chips and the brand sticker.

physics.$comment: paper sky over a kraft WORKBENCH (the board: the circuit lies on it) with a mustard trim and a LIGHT blueprint TABLE (sky-blue grid paper, cream rules) that holds the result and card sheets. No dark blocks (PD-17 backgrounds stay light).

chemistry.$comment: paper sky over a grid-paper lab BENCH (the board: atoms and formula), a mustard lip and a mid-tone speckled teal COUNTER that holds the sheets. No dark blocks.

biology.$comment: the reference world: paper sky, two torn grass strips under the board, soil below that holds the sheets.

font.$comment: Installed on this Mac only, no remote fonts. The reference's --font stack ('Noto Sans', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', 'Noto Sans Bengali', 'Kohinoor Devanagari', ...) rendered as Kohinoor Devanagari (the first INSTALLED family); v2 names it first so the look does not depend on a missing font. Chips mix sans, Georgia (serif) and Courier New (mono) exactly as the reference tiles. Indic families stay for the Assamese/Hindi adaptations.
font.sans: "Kohinoor Devanagari", "Kohinoor Bangla", "Avenir Next", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif
font.math: "Kohinoor Devanagari", "Avenir Next", "Helvetica Neue", "STIX Two Text", "STIX Two Math", system-ui, sans-serif

type.$comment: px at 1080. Floors from SZ (heading 59, label 50, equation 63) and A2 (labels >= 52, equations >= 72, subscripts >= 40). Chips use the headline size. Phone check: px * 360/1080.

compare.$comment: two-row CompareStates in the result lane

subscript.$comment: true subscripts (tspan + baseline drop), never Unicode subscript code points (A2-18). 72 px formula gives 44.6 px subscripts.

wordmark.$comment: end-card brand sticker, two lines in the title lane

ident.$comment: brand chrome, not learner-critical; one line; shown <= 2.5 s

card.$comment: card lane text (PD-18) at the label floor; 4 rows of 58 px fit the 268 px card sheet

lanes.$comment: Usable band y 250..1470 (SZ platform_insets_px.generic_conservative top 250 / bottom 450, still PLACEHOLDER) and x 96..960. v2 has NO lockup lane (PD-21): the title lane starts at 250 and gets the 48 px back (two chip rows fit). The opening ident is not a lane: it is an absolutely placed sticker in the top band (ident y0..y1, above the title lane, inside the side margins) from frame 0 to brand.ident.out_end_s. board = the diagram lane = the world region where the hero lives; result = a paper sheet; card = a paper sheet with tape (layout 'carded', PD-18); caption = a chip row (layout 'captioned').

fill.$comment: QA floors. hero = the persistent object's ink bbox height / diagram lane height (founder brief 70 %). diagram share = diagram lane height / 1920 (A2 >= 45 %; captioned 0.375; carded 0.30: the board plus a card sheet, PD-18).

stroke.$comment: bold strokes: a 10 px wire is 3.3 px on a 360 px phone and survives compression. link_under = the cream outline under a dashed connector so it reads on every band.

badge.$comment: Badge = a label chip (badge.js). style -> chip role.

motion.$comment: Durations in s (D section 2: reveal 180-300 ms, emphasis 180-350 ms, conceptual transform 400-900 ms). Each verb has one fixed default; values outside the class range warn (W_VERB_DURATION). Ease 'out' = cubic out, 'standard' = cubic in-out: no elastic, back, bounce or spring anywhere; measured quantities never overshoot. Reveal lead 0.05 s (SZ motion.reveal_lead_s).

Chips.$comment: a whole phrase of chips pops together, stagger chip_stagger_s (<= 0.04 s) by index; never word-by-word

Emphasize.$comment: one halo bump behind the element; never scales, never wobbles

Card.$comment: a card or one of its rows appears whole on its word (PD-18); opacity only

brand.$comment: Audience-facing identity is exactly 'Professor Diki Simplified'. PD-21: it appears ONLY as the opening ident (from frame 0, gone by out_end_s <= 2.5 s, over the complete board) and on the end card (wordmark chips in the title lane + the 'Free lesson: <topic>' chip from display.ui.endcard_line2). PD-20: no disclosure line on screen; the end card triggers on the last outro.brand (v2) or outro.disclosure (v1) beat and never shows its text.

sticker.$comment: The brand sticker (ident and end-card wordmark): one black plaque with the cream die-cut outline, soft shadow and a pink washi strip; all words but the last in Georgia bold cream, the last word in sans heavy mustard. Distinct from the ransom headline chips so 'Professor Diki Simplified' never reads as part of the question.

gates.$comment: build_scene.py STRUCTURAL bans (PD-19 reverses the A2 decoration ban: washi, polaroid, ransom, grain and torn paper are the house style). Each pattern is a Python regex searched in the built file; 'code' = outside the JSON data blocks, 'all' = everywhere. The brand gate (brand.forbidden_on_screen, case-insensitive, everywhere) and lint level 1 also run.

banned_patterns.why: CSS transitions run on the wall clock
CSS animations run on the wall clock
CSS animations run on the wall clock
rAF does not fire in BeginFrame capture
no elastic, back, bounce or spring easing

contrast.$comment: GENERATED by tools/build_tokens.py: WCAG ratios, text >= 4.5 on every surface it can sit on, graphics >= 3. band.* is recorded only (text never sits on a band).
